name: Greywatch
opening: The signal fire on Greywatch Tower is burning again, green this time, though no one has kept watch here for a hundred years. Crows circle the broken battlements, calling your name.
picture: a ruined stone watchtower on a stormy hill, green fire burning at the top, crows circling
beats: Find out who lit the green fire
Help the old knight finish his oath
secret: The ghost of the last knight lit the fire because he never finished his final watch.
